title: Remnant Soul Returns
next_chapter_hook: Chen Tiangming revealed that he had foreseen Chen Ji's achievements a thousand years ago, but the true test was just beginning. Another figure faintly emerged from the temporal rift, and its presence chilled everyone present—the gaze of the Heavenly Eye had quietly descended.

text.content: The temporal rift was like a wound torn across the sky, its dark edges churning with chaotic ashes. A pale hand slowly emerged, its five fingers withered like ancient thousand-year trees, yet radiating a terrifying pressure. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—the palm lines were identical to his left hand.

dialogue.content: (Mind churning) This aura... impossible! Father shouldn't have...

text.content: Slowly emerging from the rift was a figure in azure robes, fluttering in the wind, with snow-white hair. His features bore seven-tenths resemblance to Chen Ji, but between his brows carried a world-weary desolation. Those deep eyes were like abysses, as if holding entire star seas, yet also concealing endless weariness. The remnant soul was ethereal, yet its momentum shook heaven and earth.

dialogue.content: (Tears streaming down) Father... is it truly you? Your child has searched for you so desperately...

text.content: Chen Tiangming's gaze passed over Chen Nian and landed on Chen Ji. That gaze held complex emotions—relief, heartache, and a hint of subtle guilt. He drifted down gracefully, yet his ethereal form cast a faint shadow on the ground, as if he were still a living person.

dialogue.content: (Suppressing churning emotions, clasping hands in salute) Junior Chen Ji greets the senior. May I ask the reason for your late-night visit?
(Sighing softly, the remnant soul rippling slightly) Such formality between father and son. Why this distance? Ji'er, you've played the 'useless' act for a full thousand years. Are you tired?

text.content: These words caused a thunderclap from a clear sky. Chen Ji's expression instantly froze, the sharp light in his pupils flickering and fading. The surrounding air seemed to solidify, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul within the Tianji Record shuddered violently, as if witnessing something inconceivable.

dialogue.content: (Mental alarm bells ringing, yet maintaining composure) The senior jokes. This junior is merely a menial servant of Tianqing Sect—where is this talk of acting? As for the senior... how can one who perished a thousand years ago appear as a remnant soul?

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Tiangming unexpectedly showed a rare smile. That smile was identical to the satisfied smirk Chen Ji wore after a successful scheme—the father's cunning was exactly the same. He stepped forward slowly, raising his ethereal hand to gently rest on Chen Ji's shoulder.

dialogue.content: Ji'er, when you use the Tianji Record to deduce the world's trends, did you ever consider that your father's remnant soul has been quietly guarding you? Half of the tribulations you believed you cleverly avoided were actually quietly erased by your father behind the scenes.

text.content: (Fingertips trembling slightly, inner seas churning) So that's how it was... Those seemingly hopeless situations always found inexplicable turning points. I thought it was the Tianji Record's divine intervention, but it was Father secretly helping me?

choice.prompt: Facing his father's truth, how should Chen Ji respond?

choices.text: Accept the truth, inquire about his father's plans
choices.description: Since Father already knows everything, why not take the opportunity to ask about the complete picture of this thousand-year chess game and its ultimate purpose
choices.visible_cost: Expose the side of relying on his father
choices.visible_reward: Gain more truth about the Tianji Record

text.content: (Drawing a deep breath, slowly raising his gaze) Since that's the case, may Father tell me why you faked your death to escape back then? What truly is the secret of the Tianji Record over these thousand years?

dialogue.content: (Nodding) An excellent question. I faked my death back then to divert the Heavenly Eye's attention. The true holder of the Tianji Record cannot be exposed, or divine punishment will surely follow.

choices.text: Maintain suspicion, test the father's intentions
choices.description: Countless scheming across a thousand years—Chen Ji trusts no one, not even a so-called blood relative. He must first verify authenticity.
choices.visible_reward: To probe for more hidden information
choices.risk_hint: If the father is truly an enemy, this might expose his trump card

text.content: (Eyes slightly cold, composed) Everything you say, Elder, is most extraordinary. I dare to ask, do you have proof that what you say is not false?

dialogue.content: (Suddenly laughs loudly) Good! What a non-gullible person! This is my son, Chen Tianming. Come, let your father show you something.

choices.text: Directly question why he abandoned his family
choices.description: Regardless of any grand schemes, abandoning his wife and children for a thousand years is an unforgivable fact. Chen Ji demands an explanation

text.content: (Lifts head sharply, a flash of anger in eyes) Since you could foresee everything, did you foresee the abandonment scheme? Mother died with hatred, Nian was captured by the Holy Sect and suffered greatly - is this your grand plan?!

dialogue.content: (The remnant soul trembles violently, face contorted in pain) Ji'er, Father... has failed you all. But if I hadn't done so, the Heavenly Eye would have wiped out the entire Chen clan. This is the greatest debt I owe in this lifetime.

text.content: Before he could finish speaking, Chen Tianming waved his hand. A dazzling star chart unfolded in the air, with countless points of light flickering like fireflies. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly—the star chart was almost identical to the destiny trajectory shown in his Tianji Record, even more detailed.

dialogue.content: A thousand years ago, when I obtained the Tianji Record, I glimpsed a fragment of the future. You will be the key to ending the Heavenly Eye, but before that, you must gather all the fragments. The Tianji Record has nine pages, scattered across the world. Your father spent his entire life finding only three.

text.content: (A great tempest rages in his heart) Nine pages... I currently only have three fragmented pages of the Tianji Record. Where are the other six? Do those ancient forbidden lands and demonic path sacred sites all contain fragments of the Tianji Record?

choice.prompt: Which section does Chen Ji want to inquire about first regarding the whereabouts of the Tianji Record fragments?

choices.text: Ask about the easiest fragment clues
choices.description: Start from the easiest place, advance steadily, prioritize obtaining known fragments

text.content: (After pondering for a moment) Father, could you first tell me where those three fragments are now? Your child's strength is still weak; I'm afraid I cannot venture into dangerous places.

choices.text: Directly inquire about the most dangerous fragments
choices.description: High risk, high reward - first solve the biggest threat then handle the rest, seek victory through danger
choices.visible_reward: Obtain core intelligence, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao may have already sensed it

text.content: (Eyes burning intensely) This child wishes to know—which of the remaining six pages is the most dangerous? Since we must lay a scheme, we should start from the most difficult point.

choices.text: Inquire about the weaknesses of the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.description: Directly address the core issue, understand the flaws of the ultimate enemy, without wasting time on peripheral matters
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key information to counter the Eye of Heavenly Dao

text.content: (Eyes suddenly sharpening) Compared to the fragment, this child wishes to know more—what exactly is the Eye of Heavenly Dao? Why does it treat the seers as chess pieces?

Chen Tianming gazed at Chen Ji, a hint of gratification flickering in his eyes. The remnant soul rippled slightly, as if recalling something from distant times. Above the star chart, six points of light suddenly illuminated, with one of them flickering intensely, as if it might extinguish at any moment.

dialogue.content: The Eye of Heavenly Dao is not a personalized deity, but a projection of this world's will. It has no distinction between good and evil, only the instinct to maintain the world's order. And we seers... are merely chess pieces it uses to manipulate fate.

text.content: (Fists slowly clenching) So, the Tianji Record itself... is also a scheme of the Eye of Heavenly Dao? The so-called 'defying heaven to change fate' by holders throughout the ages, is merely a move on its chessboard?

dialogue.content: (Nodding) Clever. The Tianji Record is indeed a creation of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, but it has a fatal flaw—it evolves on its own. When a holder's will is strong enough, it will break free from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's control. Throughout the millennia, only a handful have achieved this.

choice.prompt: Facing this shocking truth, Chen Ji needs to make a crucial choice:

choices.text: Accept the mission and inquire how to break free
choices.description: Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao wishes to use him, he will do the opposite—turn the tables on its scheme and overturn the chessboard it has laid
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the method to break free
choices.risk_hint: May become a new chess piece

text.content: (Eyes firm and resolute) Since the Eye of Heavenly Dao treats me as a chess piece, then I shall be a piece that stirs the winds and clouds in this game. Father, please tell your child, how can one make the Tianji Record truly submit to its master?

choices.text: Question the price of this 'breaking free'
choices.description: The Eye of Heavenly Dao will not sit by idly—the price of breaking free may be losing everything, Chen Ji must weigh the pros and cons
choices.visible_reward: See the full picture of the price for breaking free
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Heavenly Dao's wrath

text.content: (Brow furrowed deeply) Wait. What happened to those who broke free from the Heavenly Dao? Are their endings also within the Heavenly Dao's calculations?

Chen Tianming's remnant soul suddenly trembled violently, as if pulled by some unseen force. He looked up at a certain point in the void, a solemn glint flickering in his eyes. The luminous dots on the star chart abruptly dimmed, and an asphyxiating pressure descended from the horizon.

dialogue.content: "It's here. Remember, Ji'er—the key to the Tianji Record recognizing its master lies not in power, but in what you truly wish to protect in your heart. The Eye of Heavenly Way can see through everything, except for a single character: 'Emotion.'"

text.content: Before the words finished, the void tore apart. A massive eye slowly opened within the rift, ruthless and cold. Within its pupil seemed to be housed the entire operating principles of heaven and earth. The Eye of Heavenly Way had descended.

Chen Ji's Tianji Record suddenly burned scorching hot, the runes on the fragment flickering madly, as if responding to some summoning. He felt an invisible force attempting to invade his Mental Sea, prying into all his secrets. The pressure was as heavy as mountains—ordinary people would have had their souls shattered long ago.

dialogue.content: (Gritting teeth while enduring, secretly mobilizing the Tianji Record) Want to see my trump card? Dream on! I, Chen Ji, plan without miss—how could I fail here!

(The remnant soul erupted with brilliant light, enveloping Chen Ji) Go! Your father will block it for you! You have three breaths of time—take Nian'er and leave this place! Remember, the sixth luminous point on the star chart—that is your only chance of survival!

text.content: Chen Tianming's figure rushed toward the Eye of Heavenly Way, his remnant soul burning, releasing the final dazzling brilliance. That light carried the wisdom and conviction of a millennium's布局, like a moth darting into flames as it collided with that cold, giant eye.

dialogue.content: (Casting one final glance, gentle yet resolute) Ji'er, Nian'er... Your father's greatest pride in this life is you both. Go, complete our mission!

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, his knuckles white. Tears swirled in his eyes, but he forced them back. He grabbed Chen Nian's hand and rushed into the night without looking back. Behind him, his father's remnant soul collided with the Eye of Heavenly Way, erupting in an earth-shaking thunder.

Chen Nian was dragged along by her brother as they fled desperately. Looking back, she saw her father's form disintegrating inch by inch under the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Way. That once majestic silhouette transformed into countless motes of light, scattered like fireflies across the night sky. Tears blurred her vision, but she dared not cry aloud—for her brother's hand was ice-cold and trembling.

After an unknown duration of running, Chen Ji finally stopped before a mountain cave. He gasped heavily, his face pale as paper. The Tianji Record in his arms trembled violently, and an aged voice emerged from within—the remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng.

dialogue.content: "Young master, the master sealed all his millennium's power into the Tianji Record. This force is enough to temporarily shield you from the Eye of Heavenly Way's prying. But the price is... the master's remnant soul will completely dissipate between heaven and earth."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly lifted his head, gazing at the night sky. His father's final glance—that gentle yet proud gaze—seemed to still flicker before his eyes. He drew a deep breath, pressing the Tianji Record tightly against his chest. A single tear finally slipped down his cheek, only to be hastily wiped away.

dialogue.content: (Voice hoarse, yet revealing an iron-like will) I've memorized it. Father's sacrifice, the Eye of Heavenly Way's gaze... One day, I will personally settle this debt.

text.content: Outside the cave, the night wind howled. Chen Ji held the Tianji Record, feeling his father's lingering warmth within it. The sixth luminous point on the star chart emerged clearly in his mind. He knew—the new chess game had just begun.
